item.title: Vivica A. Fox Delivers Festive Power Dressing in Retrofête and René Caovilla for The Christmas Campaign Press Tour
item.description: Vivica A. Fox brings full holiday glamour to NYC in a burgundy Retrofête dress and sparkling René Caovilla heels while promoting her Lifetime film The Christmas Campaign.

item.title: The Power of Neutral Heels: How Mila Kunis & Kerry Washington Coordinated Their Footwear for the Wake Up Dead Man Premiere
item.description: See Mila Kunis's $1,380 The New Arrivals gown paired with crystal-trimmed block heels, and Kerry Washington's seamless head-to-toe look featuring chocolate Rodo 'Mia' pumps. Get the style breakdown!

item.title: Cynthia Erivo Wears Louboutins on Repeat: Inside Her Fiercest Wicked: For Good Promo Looks
item.description: Cynthia Erivo steps into Wicked: For Good promo season in nonstop Christian Louboutins—blue suede boots, black leather platforms, and sleek Hot Chick pumps.

item.title: Gal Gadot Accepts Hollywood Icon Award in a Crystal-Studded Altuzarra Gown and Champagne Mules
item.description: Gal Gadot accepts the Hollywood Icon Award in a crystal-studded Altuzarra gown paired with champagne satin mules. See her full look and shoe details.

item.title: Ali Larter, Ciara, Chanel Iman & Victoria Justice Lead the Best Shoe Moments at the 2025 amfAR Las Vegas Gala
item.description: Discover the best shoes at the 2025 amfAR Las Vegas Gala, from Ali Larter’s clear heels to Ciara’s pumps, Chanel Iman’s leather boots, and Victoria Justice’s sequined mules.

item.title: Why Ginnifer Goodwin Can’t Stop Wearing Casadei’s ‘Flora’ Platforms on the Zootopia 2 Press Tour
item.description: Ginnifer Goodwin delivered standout fashion during the Zootopia 2 press tour—pairing gowns, polka dots, and sleek tailoring with her beloved Casadei ‘Flora’ heels.

item.title: Sweet, Spring-Ready Style: Lili Reinhart Stuns in Green Tory Burch Knit and Floral Velvet Skirt
item.description: Lili Reinhart brightens NYC in a green Tory Burch knit, velvet floral skirt, and classic logo pumps while promoting her new thriller American Sweatshop.

item.title: Alison Oliver’s Fetico Ballet Pumps & Indya Moore’s Gucci Mules Lead the Night’s Best Footwear Moments
item.description: Alison Oliver’s Fetico ballet heels and Indya Moore’s Gucci croc mules stole the spotlight at the GQ Germany Men of the Year Awards. See their best shoe moments.

item.title: Retro Velvet, Red Soles & Holiday Glam: Rebel Wilson’s Temperley London Moment at the Tinsel Town Premiere
item.description: Rebel Wilson brings vintage glamour to the Tinsel Town premiere in a velvet Temperley London dress and glossy red Christian Louboutin slingback pumps.

item.title: Cate Blanchett Rewears Her Stella McCartney Elyse Platforms for Freedom of the City Ceremony
item.description: Cate Blanchett accepts the Freedom of the City of London wearing her beloved Stella McCartney Elyse platforms, proving her commitment to chic, sustainable fashion.
